name_en: Nita kumoji — sour leaf pickles simmered fresh with sesame oil
summary_ja: 塩抜きしたかぶの葉の漬物を油で炒め、醤油やみりんで水分がなくなるまで煮しめる飛騨地域の一品。春先に酸っぱくなった漬物を捨てずに食べ切る知恵から生まれたとされ、仕上げにごま油と白ごまを効かせるという。
summary_en: Salt-leached turnip-leaf pickles are stir-fried in oil, then simmered down in soy sauce and mirin until the liquid is gone — a dish of the Hida region born from the wisdom of using up pickles that had turned sour by early spring, finished with a hit of sesame oil and seeds.
source_title: 煮たくもじ 岐阜県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tsukemono misoni — cut pickled napa cabbage simmered in bean miso
summary_ja: 白菜の切り漬けを煮干しだしと郡上味噌の鍋で煮込む郡上市の一品。炭焼き小屋の作業者が鯖缶を器代わりに漬物を入れて食べたのが始まりと伝わり、酸味の出た古漬けほど味が良いとされるという。
summary_en: Cut pickled napa cabbage simmers in a pot of dried-sardine stock and Gujo bean miso — a dish of Gujo City said to have begun with charcoal-kiln workers using an empty mackerel tin as a pot for their pickles, where the more soured the old pickle, the better it's said to taste.
source_title: 漬物味噌煮 岐阜県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
